parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `URLTagTests.parsesURLLink` (line 279) and `URLTagTests.parsesURLWithComplexQueryString` (line 315) — reside in the same test file `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and both carry `is_test: true`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.714) is expected for test methods that exercise the same parser code path (`URLTagTests`) but with intentionally distinct inputs: a plain URL link versus a URL with a complex query string. Collapsing them into a single parameterised test would obscure the distinct failure modes each case is designed to catch, and the divergence in inputs is the entire point of having two separate test cases.
